title: Hanaden Coverage Event (JaCoCo-compatible)
description: A single JSONL record representing a coverage measurement. Maps to JaCoCo's package→class→method→counter hierarchy via timing-as-coverage.

trace_id.description: 32-char hex trace ID linking to the same run

methods_covered.description: Number of test methods that PASSED (maps to METHOD counter covered)

methods_total.description: Total test methods in this class (maps to METHOD counter total)

lines_covered.description: Sum of assertion lines in passing tests (maps to LINE counter covered)

lines_total.description: Sum of all assertion lines (maps to LINE counter total)
